Dopaminergic drugs may cause intense urges (gambling, sex, spending, binge eating) that patients can't control; ask patients or caregivers about them specifically.

D2 antagonists (eg, phenothiazines, butyrophenones, risperidone) and isoniazid may reduce levodopa's effect; phenytoin and papaverine have reversed its benefit. High-protein meals may delay absorption, and iron salts (eg, in multivitamins) may reduce it.
